steps.instruction: Write file skeleton. Imports: os, logging, datetime (date, datetime), psycopg2, RealDictCursor, dotenv, engine.base. _get_conn() EXACTLY as mandatory_patterns. Class with all attributes. Methods have 'pass'. ASCII only.

Implement _find_routine(). Lowercase the message. Remove trigger phrases: 'mark complete', 'routine done', 'check off', 'done with', 'completed', 'finished', 'did my', 'done'. Normalize whitespace. Use _get_conn(). Query: SELECT id, title FROM routines WHERE is_active = true AND LOWER(title) ILIKE %s with f'%{cleaned}%'. If exactly one match, return it. If multiple, return first. If none, try each word individually. Return dict with id and title, or None. CRITICAL: use 'title' not 'name'. try/finally close.

Implement _mark_complete(). Use _get_conn(). Get today = date.today(). Use INSERT ON CONFLICT: INSERT INTO routine_completions (routine_id, due_date, status, completed_at, completed_by) VALUES (%s, %s, 'completed', NOW(), 'adge') ON CONFLICT (routine_id, due_date) DO UPDATE SET status = 'completed', completed_at = NOW(), completed_by = 'adge' RETURNING id. Params: (routine_id, today). conn.commit(). Return the id. try/finally close.

Implement execute(). Call _find_routine(request.message). If None: return SkillResponse(skill_name=self.name, data={}, summary='Could not find a matching routine. Active routines: Check calendar, Import Bank Transactions, Review transactions.', confidence=0.3, sources=['mythos.routines']). If found: call _mark_complete(routine['id'], routine['title']). Return SkillResponse(skill_name=self.name, data={'routine_id': routine['id'], 'routine_title': routine['title'], 'completion_id': comp_id}, summary=f'Marked "{routine["title"]}" as complete for today.', confidence=0.95, sources=['mythos.routines', 'mythos.routine_completions']). try/except/finally.

Review. Uses 'title' NOT 'name' for routines. _get_conn uses POSTGRES_HOST. conn.commit() after INSERT. ON CONFLICT handles re-completion gracefully. SkillResponse uses ONLY valid kwargs. Summary never empty. ASCII only. Production-ready.
